authority_resolution.question: Does the current owner mutation-admission decision remain irrevocable through its effective interval after owner apply while the global RecoveryCodePolicy version is unchanged?

existing_authority.finding: Sensitive operations resolve required assurance at execution time; exact operation-bound evidence is constrained by authorized context.
Policy versions carry status/effective interval/lineage/evidence; runtime resolves required policy at effective time and scope, failing missing/ambiguous controls.
Current owner authority and expected version/policy are revalidated; independent current authority remains after mutation.
Revalidate current source, expected resource/policy/version, replacement plan and intervals at final execution time.

existing_authority.reference: Frozen seam-v2 bff-wire-v3 owner_admission and ownership-and-currentness final_validity
existing_authority.finding: Original owner admission is bound and compared at apply; final exact source/plan/policy/interval checks remain required.
Identity remains owner authority; no contrary irrevocability or policy-lock guarantee.

authority_resolution.scope_limits: Relevant-flow file currently declares no flow references. Existing frozen009 authority/preparation names FigJam38/42; no external board operation or new external claim was made for this source issue.
authority_resolution.conclusion: Existing authority resolves this as an implementation currentness defect. An effective interval is a validity bound, not a guarantee that a separate owner policy cannot be withdrawn/superseded. The interface's common-row locks do not promise to serialize every owner admission policy source.

source_locations.detail: Local/no provider I/O/no mutation and common owner locks; no immutable-decision-through-commit contract.
Apply resolves and compares Allowed/plan/policy/evidence/interval once before returning the applied outcome.
Current method/operation/proof checks await after owner apply and before final decisionAt.
Final guard re-resolves global recovery policy and publication, but owner admission is reduced to captured admissionInterval.Contains(at).

finding.trigger: An owner admission source changes Allowed, admission policy/evidence or exact target decision after apply and during a later awaited shared authority check; global recovery policy/publication and pinned Account/set rows remain unchanged and the old interval still contains decisionAt.
finding.effect: The final guard can commit issuance/retirement/proof/outbox and release first delivery using the no-longer-current owner grant.
not_claimed: A production owner policy was chosen
Every in-memory source change is necessarily legitimate business authority
Current row locks are ineffective for the rows they actually cover

narrow_remedy_proposal.shape: Add a required synchronous typed pure current-resolution method on the same recovery mutation-admission source, or an equivalent closed typed final-currentness method returning current admission. No arbitrary callback, default captured-decision implementation, network I/O or new policy values.
narrow_remedy_proposal.witness: Capture the actual typed source, immutable original request/prior facts and original admission at recovery-owned construction. At existing final decisionAt re-resolve for that same Account/version/kind/global-policy/original facts with EffectiveAt=decisionAt.
required_comparison: canonical exact retirement targets and lifecycle versions
original interval identity with existing persistence precision normalization and actual decisionAt membership
narrow_remedy_proposal.finality: False, missing, ambiguous or throwing source resolution rejects within the existing transaction and carrier disposal path. Original pre-mutation facts remain the request basis; do not ask the owner to approve the already-mutated tracking graph as a new operation.
narrow_remedy_proposal.boundaries: The final pure decision has the same existing final-decision/commit semantics as other authority checks; no claim of global distributed irrevocability or new long-held policy lock.

proposed_regressions.timing: Flip the typed owner admission only after actual owner apply and within a later awaited authentication/continuation check, keeping global policy, publication, original row facts and old interval otherwise stable.
cases: Different exact retirement target of same cardinality
assertions: All password/passkey/TOTP completion wrappers reach the same final guard
Original operation remains pending and proof unconsumed after rollback
Owned mutable payload disposed on rejection
